Coordination Premiums in Small Teams (synthetic test fixture)

We study a stylized model of teams with specialists and coordinators.
In the baseline setting with an outside option of 0.25, coordinators earn 2.41 while specialists earn 4.15.
As automation spreads, coordinators earn relatively more compared to specialists, although absolute wages for both groups decline.
Specialists are not displaced; they move into niche markets where automated tools are weaker.
All numbers above are illustrative values from the model, not forecasts.
